name: Prince Edward Island
title: PEI Rebate Calculator 2026: Insulation, Windows and Free Upgrades
h1: Prince Edward Island Rebate Calculator 2026: What You Could Get Back
desc: Free PEI rebate calculator. Free home insulation under $55,000 income, efficiencyPEI insulation, window and air sealing rebates, and what happened to the heat pump rebate. Every number sourced.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Prince Edward Island rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: PEI's heat pump rebates ended on April 15, 2026, and applications for free heat pumps are closed. Insulation help is still open: free insulation for homeowners with income under $55,000 and a home assessed at $300,000 or less, and rebates for insulation, windows and air sealing for everyone else.
faq: Is there still a heat pump rebate in PEI?

Not for new purchases. PEI's heat pump rebates ended on April 15, 2026. If you bought a heat pump between April 15, 2025 and April 15, 2026, you can still apply online, within one year of buying it. Applications for free heat pumps are closed.
Who gets free insulation in PEI?

Homeowners with a total household income under $55,000, who live in the home all year, and whose home has a tax assessed value of $300,000 or less. Apply in person at an Access PEI office and wait for approval before any work starts.
How much is the PEI energy audit?
$99 plus HST. The province pays the rest. You need the audit before you can claim the Home Insulation Rebates, and you book it with an approved company, not with efficiencyPEI.
Can I get a federal heat pump rebate too?
The federal National Heat Pump Rebate was announced on October 8, 2026 and is expected to start in early 2027. The income line and rules are not published yet, so we do not add it to your total.

programs.name: Home Insulation Rebates: windows, doors and skylights (low income)
programs.rules: $245 per opening up to $2,000 per property. ENERGY STAR version 5 (2020 or newer). Household income under $35,000, shown with the July Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit notice. Audit before and after.

programs.name: Home Insulation Rebates: windows, doors and skylights
programs.rules: $125 per opening up to $1,000 per property. ENERGY STAR version 5 (2020 or newer). Audit before and after.

programs.name: Home Insulation Rebates: insulation
programs.rules: Rebate = 100-square-foot units times the R-value you add times the rate. Attic $3.50, walls $10 to $50, floors and headers $21, below grade $21. Low income rates are higher. Shown but not added to your total because it depends on your home.

programs.name: Home Insulation Rebates: air sealing
programs.rules: Paid by how much your air leakage drops: 10%, 20% or 30% better than the first audit. Shown but not added to your total.

programs.name: Free Home Insulation
programs.rules: Own the home, live in it all year, income under $55,000, tax assessed value $300,000 or less. Apply in person at Access PEI and wait for approval before any work.

programs.name: Subsidized home energy assessment
programs.rules: Required for the Home Insulation Rebates. Book with an approved company. Not added to your total.

programs.name: National Heat Pump Rebate (federal, not open yet)
programs.rules: Announced October 8, 2026 and expected to launch in early 2027. The income line, eligible homes and how it combines with provincial programs are not published, so this is shown but not added to your total.
